referenceFunction.generalComment: this flax is for the textile industry (flax for food industry is another species of flax with very different yields of grains and fibres, and possibly different agricultural processes). Inventory refers to the production of 8'110 kg flax fibres, at farm respectively 300 kg flax grains, at farm (representing 1 ha culture), both with a moisture content of 15%.; UUID: ccf251da-b0ba-3978-a393-ff59629e8732
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the processes of soil cultivation, sowing, weed control, fertilisation, pest and pathogen control, fibres and grain harvest, grain cleansing and grain refrigerated storage. The direct emissions on the field are included, as well as agricultural machinery dedicated to flax cultivation.
referenceFunction.name: Flax culture, flax straw

geography.text: Refers to an average production in Haute-Normandie region, France. This region produces about half of french total flax production for textile industry, which rises at 25% of world production.

timePeriod.text: The yield data have been collected for the years 2005-2013.

representativeness.productionVolume: The studied agricultural cooperative produces about 25% of total flax production for textile industry in France (considering figures of FAOSTAT for 2012, production of flax fibres and tows, which are co-products of subsequent processes : scutching and combing).
